checkpoints.title: First domain or encoding checkpoint
checkpoints.contract: The small immutable first checkpoint described in its source; no later service features are claimed.

checkpoints.title: Deterministic lease and fencing model
checkpoints.contract: An in-memory queue retains at most16 jobs,256-byte payloads, three claims per job, and ten logical ticks per lease. Exact enqueue retries have no new effect; conflicting payloads fail. Expiry permits redelivery and a newer token fences old completion. Cancellation revokes completion. No database, OS clock, background worker, or external effect is implemented.

checkpoints.title: Complete reference implementation
checkpoints.contract: The current complete reference source with its documented limits, fixtures, tests and operational requirements. Database tests remain explicit opt-in checks where applicable.
